original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹评论员奥亚伊在阿联酋被无指控拘留一年
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 人权观察称，南苏丹政治评论员塞缪尔·彼得·奥亚伊在阿联酋被无指控拘留已满一年，阿联酋当局未向其家人披露逮捕的法律依据。据一名知情人士称，奥亚伊于2025年9月30日在迪拜家中被便衣安全人员逮捕。人权观察呼吁阿联酋立即释放奥亚伊。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹政治评论员奥亚伊在阿联酋被无指控拘留一年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A South Sudanese political commentator remains in prison in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) without charge a year after his arrest, Human Rights Watch said today.

key_facts.fact: 阿联酋当局未向奥亚伊家人披露逮捕的法律依据
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Emirati authorities have not disclosed the legal basis for the arrest of the commentator, Samuel Peter Oyay, to his family.

key_facts.fact: 据一名知情人士称，奥亚伊于2025年9月30日在迪拜家中被便衣安全人员逮捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On September 30, 2025, Emirati security forces in civilian clothes arrested Oyay in front of his four children at their home in Dubai after searching his home for two hours, an informed source told Human Rights Watch.

key_facts.fact: 人权观察呼吁阿联酋立即释放奥亚伊
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Emirati authorities should immediately release Samuel Oyay, who has been held for a year without charge.

uncertainties: 逮捕及拘留细节主要依据一名知情人士向人权观察的陈述，尚未获得独立交叉验证
阿联酋当局未公开逮捕的法律依据，相关指控尚未获官方确认
